defaults.source: Distilled from [developer.shopware.com](https://developer.shopware.com) plus the Shopware 6.7 source, retrieved 2026-08-20. Coding guidelines and ADRs come from the shopware/shopware repository.

guidelines.title: Shopware coding guidelines
guidelines.description: Shopware coding guidelines: code structure, domain exceptions, extendability rules, ADR knowledge, documentation guidelines. Use when reviewing Shopware code against the platform's own conventions.
guidelines.intro: The platform's own rules for platform-shaped code. Domain exceptions and extendability are where most plugins diverge.

analysis.title: Shopware static analysis
analysis.description: Shopware static analysis: PHPStan and its Shopware extension, ECS and PHP-CS-Fixer, Deptrac, Rector. Use when configuring or fixing Shopware static analysis.
analysis.intro: The tool chain a Shopware plugin is expected to pass, with the configuration each one needs.

release.title: Shopware release hygiene
release.description: Shopware release hygiene: README and changelog conventions, and the knowledge-sync process for keeping distilled documentation current. Use when preparing a Shopware plugin release.
release.intro: What ships alongside the code, and how this library keeps itself current.
